tool_args.rationale: Fresh confirmation RMSE (2.806) greatly exceeds tolerance despite zero training error. Acquire the specifically recommended high-s_grad regime probe before selecting or fitting an extended law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit an extended or piecewise siphon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation strongly refuted the smooth pilot fit, and the diagnostic specifically identifies the unprobed high-s_grad regime as the next informative measurement.
No evidence yet points to a coupled temporal-memory mechanism; the targeted high-s_grad probe is cheaper and directly tests the suspected threshold/avalanche behavior.
The refutation is consistent with an unmeasured stationary regime break, not evidence of chaotic oscillation or that all smooth mechanisms fail.
